FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Which jewellery has 3% making?

Gold jewellery at our showroom carries a 3% making charge, all 365 days of the year. If any design differs, we tell you before billing.

How do I find out the price?

Every design has an "Ask price" button. We send you the full breakup based on that day's gold rate.

Can I reserve a design in advance?

Yes. Send us the design and your visit date on WhatsApp, and we will keep it aside for you.

Coming from Orai or Ait?

Call us before you leave. We will keep designs in your budget ready so you save time.
